resolution: Changed imported prop collision from radius-square to measured rectangular footprints. The importer now records local X/Z extents, Desk.glb regenerates as a 2.309897m by 1.149652m footprint, live editor prop footprint/picking uses the rectangle, and the compiled mesh-props lump/loader now ships and collides imported meshes as oriented rectangles.
